replaceable_read_actions.description: Authenticates plaintext legacy token against SHA-256 hash in auth_tokens, updates last_used_at, and returns safe role and alias metadata.
Aggregates summary counts (members, campaigns, donors, pending registrations, unverified proofs) for initial Admin dashboard render.
Returns pending member registrations awaiting approval as part of Stage 1 dashboard payload.
Returns pending late donor requests awaiting admin decision as part of Stage 1 dashboard payload.
Returns paginated list of campaigns with donor count, collected totals, deadline metrics, and linked PIC aliases with status filter support.
Returns paginated, searchable, and filterable member directory (search by name/whatsapp, filter by status/role).
Consolidates PIC token metadata, linked campaign details, progress metrics, and prioritized donor action queue into a single call.
Returns domain summary metrics, pending queues, and system settings (with secret values masked) for SuperAdmin console.
Verifies donor WhatsApp registration status and returns identity state (active, pending, or unregistered).
Returns joined campaigns with billings and unjoined open campaigns for the authenticated donor.
Embeds PIC campaigns owned by the donor's WhatsApp phone directly in the donor dashboard payload.
Embedded in dashboard RPC payloads (rounding configuration, active thresholds).

mutations.ui_trigger: userLogin() in js/views/auth.js -> Registration form (#u-register-fields), button #btn-u-login ('Selesaikan Pendaftaran')
mutations.expected_side_effects: Normalizes WhatsApp to E.164, inserts member with status='PENDING' and role='MEMBER', logs self-registration audit entry.
validation_rules: Name must not be empty
WhatsApp must be valid Indonesian phone number
empStatus must be in ('active', 'ex')
WhatsApp must not already exist as active member

mutations.ui_trigger: saveProfile() in js/views/donor.js -> Profile modal (#profile-modal), button 'Simpan Profil'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates name and optional email in members record; updates modified_by and modified_at timestamp.
validation_rules: WhatsApp must belong to an existing active member
Name must not be empty
Email must be valid format if provided

mutations.ui_trigger: seamlessBecomePic() in js/views/donor.js -> Button '+ Buat Campaign Baru (Jadi PIC)' in user dashboard
mutations.expected_side_effects: Generates a new PIC token ('PIC-XXXX'), stores SHA-256 hash in auth_tokens with role='PIC', status='UNUSED', created_by=whatsapp, returns plaintext token to client.
validation_rules: Caller WhatsApp must be registered in members with status='ACTIVE'
Alumni ('EX') or pending members are rejected
mutations.danger_reason: Creates authentication credentials. Unbounded creation leads to token proliferation.

mutations.ui_trigger: deleteDraftCampaign() in js/views/donor.js -> Button 'Hapus' on draft card in donor dashboard
mutations.expected_side_effects: Deletes or expires the unused PIC token record that has no linked campaign.
validation_rules: Token must exist in auth_tokens
Token must have linked_campaign_id IS NULL (draft state only)

mutations.ui_trigger: joinCampaign() in js/views/donor.js -> Button 'Gabung Donasi untuk [Target]' (#btn-join-[id])
mutations.expected_side_effects: Inserts or reactivates pledge in donors table with status='PLEDGED', amount_due=0 (or custom_amount), paid=FALSE, verified=FALSE, joined_at=NOW().
validation_rules: Campaign must exist and status must be 'OPEN'
WhatsApp must be valid
If customAmount provided, must be numeric > 0
Donor must not already have an active PLEDGED record

mutations.ui_trigger: submitBulkJoin() in js/views/donor.js -> Modal #custom-bulk-join-modal, button 'Gabung' (#btn-submit-bulk-join)
mutations.expected_side_effects: Atomically pledges the donor into multiple open campaigns in a single transaction.
validation_rules: campaignIds must be a non-empty array
Only processes campaigns that currently have status='OPEN'
If customAmount provided, must be > 0

mutations.ui_trigger: withdraw() in js/views/donor.js -> Button 'Batal ikut' (#btn-withdraw-[id])
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates donor record to donor_status='WITHDRAWN', modified_at=NOW().
validation_rules: Campaign must exist and status must be 'OPEN'
Donor must be currently PLEDGED in the campaign
Cannot withdraw if campaign status is CLOSED, FINALIZED, or ARCHIVED

mutations.ui_trigger: submitProof() in js/views/donor.js -> Button 'Sudah transfer, kirim bukti' (#btn-submit-proof-[id]), file input #proof-[id]
mutations.expected_side_effects: Stores receipt storage path, marks donors.paid=TRUE, paid_at=NOW, amount_paid=amount_due, verified=FALSE.
validation_rules: Campaign must be 'FINALIZED'
Donor must be PLEDGED in the campaign
Proof file must be valid image or PDF (max 2MB)

mutations.ui_trigger: submitCombinedProof() in js/views/donor.js -> Button 'Konfirmasi Transfer' (#btn-submit-combined-[acc]), file input #combined-proof-[acc]
mutations.expected_side_effects: Atomically marks multiple donor campaign pledges as paid=TRUE with shared proof link/path in one transaction.
validation_rules: campaignIds must be a non-empty array
All targeted campaigns must be FINALIZED and share identical bank details
Proof file must be valid image or PDF (max 2MB)

mutations.ui_trigger: createCampaign() in js/views/pic.js -> Form in #view-pic-create, button #btn-create-campaign ('Buat campaign')
mutations.expected_side_effects: Creates new campaign record (status='OPEN'), links campaign_id to auth_tokens, transitions token status to 'ACTIVE'.
validation_rules: PIC token must be valid and unused (linked_campaign_id IS NULL)
targetName and deadline are mandatory
giftAmount must be numeric >= 0

mutations.ui_trigger: closeList() in js/views/pic.js -> Button 'Tutup pendaftaran' in PIC actions
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates campaigns.status='CLOSED', modified_at=NOW(). Locks donor list from new public joins.
validation_rules: PIC token must be valid and own the linked campaign
Campaign status must currently be 'OPEN'

mutations.ui_trigger: reopenList() in js/views/pic.js -> Button 'Buka lagi pendaftaran' in PIC actions
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates campaigns.status='OPEN', modified_at=NOW(). Re-allows donors to join.
validation_rules: PIC token must be valid and own the linked campaign
Campaign status must currently be 'CLOSED' or 'FINALIZED'

mutations.ui_trigger: doFinalize() in js/views/pic.js -> Button #btn-do-finalize ('Konfirmasi & finalisasi') in finalize form
mutations.expected_side_effects: Computes split algorithm (deducting custom pledges, dividing remaining balance among regular donors with rounding), updates each donor's amount_due, sets campaign status='FINALIZED', captures bank info and timestamps, queues email billing reminders.
validation_rules: PIC token must own the campaign
Campaign must have at least 1 PLEDGED donor
bankName, bankAccount, and accountHolder must not be empty
finalGiftAmount must be numeric > 0
Campaign must not be ARCHIVED
mutations.danger_reason: Irreversibly computes financial obligations and shifts campaign into collection phase. Overwriting can disrupt donor billing.

mutations.ui_trigger: submitGiftProof() in js/views/pic.js -> Form #gift-proof-form, button 'Simpan Dokumentasi Hadiah'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates campaigns.gift_link and/or gift_image, modified_at=NOW().
validation_rules: PIC token must own the campaign
Campaign must be 'FINALIZED' or 'CLOSED'
At least link or image file must be supplied

mutations.ui_trigger: verifyPaymentUI() in js/views/pic.js -> Buttons 'Konfirmasi' (isValid=true) / 'Tolak' (isValid=false) on donor verification stack
mutations.expected_side_effects: If valid: sets verified=TRUE, modified_by=PIC. If invalid: resets paid=FALSE, proof_link=NULL, verified=FALSE.
validation_rules: PIC token must own the campaign
Donor must exist and be PLEDGED in the campaign

mutations.ui_trigger: picVerifyAllUI() in js/views/pic.js -> Button '✓ Setujui Semua Bukti' in PIC workspace
mutations.expected_side_effects: Batch marks all unverified paid donors in the campaign as verified=TRUE; returns verified count.
validation_rules: PIC token must own the campaign
Only applies to donors where paid=TRUE, verified=FALSE, and proof is present

mutations.ui_trigger: markRefundedUI() in js/views/pic.js -> Button 'Tandai Dikembalikan' on donor card/table
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates donors.refunded=TRUE, modified_by=PIC, modified_at=NOW().
validation_rules: PIC token must own the campaign
Donor must have overpaid (amount_paid > amount_due)
mutations.danger_reason: Financial reconciliation flag without external banking verification.

mutations.ui_trigger: submitLateDonor() in js/views/pic.js -> Form #late-donor-form, button 'Simpan & Masukkan ke List'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Inserts record into late_requests (request_id='REQ-XXXX', status='PENDING').
validation_rules: PIC token must own campaign
donorName, donorWhatsApp, and reason are required
Must not duplicate an existing PENDING request for same campaign & phone

mutations.ui_trigger: archiveThis() in js/views/pic.js -> Button 'Arsipkan campaign' in PIC Danger Zone
mutations.expected_side_effects: Sets campaigns.status='ARCHIVED' and expires PIC token (auth_tokens.status='EXPIRED').
validation_rules: PIC token must own campaign
Campaign must be 'FINALIZED'
mutations.danger_reason: Expires PIC access token and moves campaign to immutable archive state.

mutations.ui_trigger: deleteThis() in js/views/pic.js -> Button 'Hapus campaign' in PIC Danger Zone
mutations.expected_side_effects: Hard-deletes campaign row (cascading to donors and late_requests) and sets PIC token status to 'EXPIRED'.
validation_rules: PIC token must own campaign
Campaign status MUST be 'OPEN' or 'CLOSED'
FINALIZED or ARCHIVED campaigns are strictly forbidden from PIC deletion
mutations.danger_reason: Permanent data deletion of campaign, pledges, and donor history.

mutations.ui_trigger: approvePending() / updateMemberStatusUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Buttons 'Setujui' / 'Tolak' on pending cards, member status select dropdowns
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates members.status (ACTIVE, EX, PENDING, REJECTED, DELETED), records modified_by=admin_alias and modified_at timestamp.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
Target WhatsApp must exist in members
newStatus must be a valid status enum

mutations.ui_trigger: bulkApprovePending() in js/views/admin.js -> Buttons 'Setujui Terpilih' / 'Tolak Terpilih' on pending table toolbar
mutations.expected_side_effects: Batch updates statuses of multiple members in a single atomic transaction.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
updates must be an array of { whatsapp, status } objects

mutations.ui_trigger: executeApproveLateDonor() in js/views/admin.js -> Buttons 'Setujui' / 'Tolak' on late donor rows
mutations.expected_side_effects: If rejected: status='REJECTED'. If approved: auto-registers member if needed, injects donor pledge, recalculates campaign donor bills, updates late_requests.status='APPROVED'.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
Request must exist and status must currently be 'PENDING'

mutations.ui_trigger: genPicToken() in js/views/admin.js -> Button '+ Buat token PIC baru' in Tools PIC card
mutations.expected_side_effects: Generates unlinked PIC token, stores hash in auth_tokens with role='PIC', status='UNUSED', returns plaintext token.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
mutations.danger_reason: Creates authentication tokens. Unchecked generation leads to orphaned credentials.

mutations.ui_trigger: adminTransferOwnershipUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Modal transfer ownership section, button 'Transfer'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Expires existing PIC tokens for campaign, creates new active PIC token for target member, updates audit history.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
Target WhatsApp must be an ACTIVE member in members table
Campaign must exist
mutations.danger_reason: Transfers administrative authority over campaign funds and bank accounts.

mutations.ui_trigger: adminRecalculateUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Hitung Ulang Tagihan Donatur' in admin view modal
mutations.expected_side_effects: Recalculates amount_due across all donors in the campaign according to rounding rules without modifying payment proofs.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
Campaign must be 'FINALIZED'

mutations.ui_trigger: adminEditGiftAmountUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Modal #edit-gift-modal, button 'Simpan'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates campaigns.gift_amount, triggers campaign math recalculation across all donors if finalized.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
newAmount must be numeric > 0

mutations.ui_trigger: adminDeleteDonorUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Hapus donatur' on donor row in campaign detail modal
mutations.expected_side_effects: Deletes donor row from campaign, re-runs math recalculation for remaining donors.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
Donor must exist in campaign
mutations.danger_reason: Deletes donor record and alters remaining donors' bill amounts.

mutations.ui_trigger: adminTogglePaidUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Tandai lunas' / 'Tandai belum lunas' in admin view modal
mutations.expected_side_effects: Toggles donors.paid and donors.verified, updates amount_paid=amount_due if marking as paid, records admin modifier.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
Donor must exist in campaign

mutations.ui_trigger: editAmountPaid() in js/views/admin.js -> Modal #edit-amount-modal, button 'Simpan'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates donors.amount_paid and custom_amount to exact specified value, records admin modifier.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
amount must be numeric >= 0

mutations.ui_trigger: adminArchive() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Arsipkan' on campaign row
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates campaigns.status to newStatus (e.g. ARCHIVED), records admin modifier.
validation_rules: Caller must have ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role token
newStatus must be valid campaign status enum

mutations.ui_trigger: genAdminToken() in js/views/superadmin.js -> Form #sa-gen-admin-form, button 'Buat token Admin baru'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Generates new Admin token ('ADM-XXXX'), stores hash in auth_tokens with role='ADMIN', status='ACTIVE', returns plaintext token.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Alias is mandatory
mutations.danger_reason: Creates full administrative credentials. Must be audited and strictly restricted.

mutations.ui_trigger: revokeAdmin() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Nonaktifkan' in admin accounts table
mutations.expected_side_effects: Sets auth_tokens.status='REVOKED' and revoked_at=NOW().
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Token must exist
mutations.danger_reason: Revokes administrative access. Can lock out admins.

mutations.ui_trigger: reactivateAdmin() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Aktifkan' in admin accounts table
mutations.expected_side_effects: Sets auth_tokens.status='ACTIVE' and revoked_at=NULL.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Token must exist

mutations.ui_trigger: deleteAdmin() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Hapus' in admin accounts table
mutations.expected_side_effects: Permanently deletes token record from auth_tokens.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Token must exist

mutations.ui_trigger: assignMemberRoleUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Buttons '+ Admin' / '+ PIC' in members table
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates members.role, auto-generates appropriate role token if not present, logs audit entry.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
newRole must be in ('MEMBER', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')
Member must exist
mutations.danger_reason: Elevates user privileges to Admin or SuperAdmin.

mutations.ui_trigger: addMemberUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Form #sa-add-member-form, button 'Tambah member'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Inserts member directly with role='MEMBER', added_by='SuperAdmin', added_at=NOW().
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
name and wa are required
wa must be unique

mutations.ui_trigger: removeMemberUI() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Hapus member' in members table
mutations.expected_side_effects: Soft deletes member (status='DELETED'), records modified_by='SuperAdmin'.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Member must exist
mutations.danger_reason: Deletes member account and removes user access.

mutations.ui_trigger: adminDelete() in js/views/admin.js -> Button 'Hapus campaign' on campaign cards/tables
mutations.expected_side_effects: Permanently deletes campaign and all associated donors and late requests; expires PIC token.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Campaign must exist
mutations.danger_reason: Cascading destruction of campaign records, pledges, payment records, and proofs.

mutations.ui_trigger: saveSettings() in js/views/superadmin.js -> Form #sa-section-settings, button 'Simpan pengaturan'
mutations.expected_side_effects: Updates key-value settings in app_settings table (rounding toggles, round to amount, validation flag, notification emails, app URL).
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
settings must be a valid JSON object matching recognized keys
mutations.danger_reason: Changes global application behavior, rounding formulas, and notification routing.

mutations.ui_trigger: runDataSweep() in js/views/superadmin.js -> Button 'Bersihkan Arsip Data' in database maintenance card
mutations.expected_side_effects: Partitions or moves ARCHIVED campaigns and their donors to cold archive storage to keep active queries lean.
validation_rules: Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role token
Only processes campaigns with status='ARCHIVED'
mutations.danger_reason: Bulk data movement and cleanup across multiple tables.

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Alters core application behavior such as rounding rules, validation requirements, and notification emails globally.
protection_measures: Strict SUPER_ADMIN token validation via verify_auth_token
Validation schema enforcing proper types on all setting values
Comprehensive change logging in audit_logs with before/after snapshots

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Bulk data manipulation moving or pruning archived campaigns and donor histories.
protection_measures: Strict SUPER_ADMIN authorization
Non-destructive archiving (move to archive partition or table rather than unrecoverable DROP)
Atomic transaction wrap with explicit row count reporting in audit_logs

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Issues authentication credentials for privileged roles or campaign ownership.
protection_measures: Store only SHA-256 hashes using pgcrypto in auth_tokens
Set strict expiration intervals (expires_at) and rate limits
Enforce active member verification for seamless PIC creation
Audit token generation events with creator identity

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Revokes or destroys administrator access credentials, potentially causing lockout.
protection_measures: Require explicit confirmation and SuperAdmin verification
Prevent revocation of the primary root SuperAdmin credentials
Audit log all revocation and deletion events

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Marks financial excess as settled without banking API confirmation.
protection_measures: Verify donor genuinely overpaid (amount_paid > amount_due)
PIC ownership validation on campaign
Audit log refund settlement with PIC alias and timestamp

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Irreversibly computes split amounts, locks donor list, and captures bank info.
protection_measures: Execute calculation in a single PostgreSQL serializable transaction
Verify bank details are complete and finalGiftAmount is valid positive number
Check that pledged donor count > 0 before locking

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Deletes member profile and can break referential integrity on past pledges.
protection_measures: Implement as soft deletion (status = 'DELETED')
Ensure foreign key references in donors use ON DELETE SET NULL to preserve history
Strict SUPER_ADMIN authorization

dangerous_actions.danger_description: Cascading destruction of campaigns, pledges, payment records, and receipts.
protection_measures: Strictly disallow PIC deletion once campaign is FINALIZED or ARCHIVED
SuperAdmin emergency deletion only with explicit confirmation and full audit trail
Soft delete / archive flag preference over hard SQL DELETE where possible

top_5_recommended_rpcs.rationale: Highest volume end-user action. Enables donors to join campaigns with custom amounts and aliases. Directly unblocks the primary fundraising participation flow.
Core fulfillment action. Enables donors to upload payment proofs to Supabase Storage and mark obligations as paid, unblocking the verification and collection pipeline.
Kickoff action for campaign lifecycles. Allows active members and PICs to initiate new donation campaigns and establish database records.
Core mathematical calculation engine. Transitions campaigns from registration to payment phase, divides obligations, sets bank info, and triggers billing notices.
Core settlement verification gate. Enables PICs to review transfer proofs, approve valid payments, reject invalid uploads, and complete campaign reconciliation.
